question: How many divisions are there on a vernier scale as used in a modern vernier caliper for metric measurement?
solution:
The correct answer is __50****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A vernier scale__ is an auxiliary scale used on measuring devices like vernier calipers.
 
• It increases the precision of measurements by subdividing the smallest division on the main scale.
 
• The vernier scale in modern vernier calipers for metric measurement typically has 50 divisions.
 
• These divisions correspond to 49 main scale divisions, enabling precise readings up to 0.02 mm.
 
• Vernier calipers are widely used in engineering and scientific measurements for their accuracy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Functionality of Vernier Calipers:**
 
 
• Vernier calipers measure internal and external dimensions, as well as depths.
 
• They consist of a main scale and a sliding vernier scale.
 
 
 
• **Reading the Scale:**
 
 
• To take a measurement, align the vernier scale with the main scale and note the corresponding readings.
 
• The combination of these readings provides a precise measurement.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• Vernier calipers are used in metalworking, machining, and quality control.
 
• They are also important in educational settings for teaching measurement techniques.
